messages.text:
What I want to buy is always marked (for the last
 week or so) "available soon" and I can't order it yet.

 I don't have time to watch your videos. Please just tell me when I
 can order the thermal seat pad and some oven mitts, and if with
 that I get free delivery. It now says has to be a hundred dollar
 purchase for free delivery. An "imperfect" is fine, too, but I
 can't seem to order the imperfect items I want either.

 I don't understand the significance of your stopping
 manufacturing. But you are introducing new products? Please just
 cut to the chase instead of these videos.

 Thank you

 Sylvia

Hi Sylvia,

First, I owe you a real apology. You've sent three messages over the past several months and heard nothing back. That's a failure on our part, plain and simple, and I'm sorry it took this long.

I can see that you ordered the seat cushion. We'll let you know once it's ready, we saw the note to not ship before July.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
